title: Walk the Code Configuration
description: Schema for walk-the-code config.json — defines project metadata, chapter structure, lab definitions, and optional run commands for an interactive line-by-line code tutorial.

title.description: Project title shown on the index page.

tagline.description: Subtitle shown below the title on the index page.

repo_url.description: Repository URL used for the GitHub corner link on tutorial pages.

language.description: Default programming language for all labs. Auto-detected from file extension if omitted.

code_dir.description: Path to the code directory, relative to config.json. Defaults to the current directory.

chapters.description: Array of chapter objects that group labs into themed sections, each with its own page, description, and optional diagram.

labs.description: Array of lab objects defining individual code tutorials.

chapter.description: A chapter groups labs into a themed section with its own page, description, and optional diagram.

title.description: Chapter title displayed on the chapter page and in navigation.

description.description: HTML description shown on the chapter page.

diagram.description: Inline Mermaid source rendered on the chapter page (raw Mermaid markup, not a file reference).

comparison_diagram.description: References a .mmd file in the diagrams/ directory, shown as a comparison diagram on the chapter page.

labs.description: Ordered list of lab IDs belonging to this chapter.

lab.description: A lab defines a single code file tutorial with metadata, optional run command, learning objectives, and exercises.

id.description: Unique lab identifier. Must be a valid identifier (letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens; must start with a letter or underscore). Matches a subdirectory in code_dir.

file.description: Source file to display in the tutorial viewer.

title.description: Lab title displayed in navigation and on the lab page.

tagline.description: One-line summary shown on index and chapter pages.

description.description: HTML overview shown in the explanation panel before any line is selected.

language.description: Override the default language for this lab. Auto-detected from file extension if omitted.

run_command.description: Command to execute the lab, specified as an array of strings. Enables the Run button in local server mode. Use ["sh", "-c", "..."] for compile-then-run languages.

learning_objectives.description: Array of strings describing what the learner will be able to do after completing this lab.

exercises.description: Array of exercise objects displayed in the lab overview panel with completion checkboxes (persisted per-browser in localStorage).

exercise.description: An exercise prompts the learner to modify or experiment with the code.

prompt.description: The exercise instruction or question presented to the learner.

hint.description: Optional hint to help the learner complete the exercise.
